spec.title: Combination Sum
spec.summary: Given distinct positive candidate integers and a positive target, list every distinct multiset of candidates whose sum equals the target.
spec.description: Given distinct positive candidate integers and a positive target, list every distinct multiset of candidates whose sum equals the target. A candidate may be used any number of times. Combination order does not create a new answer; return the combinations in any order. Test data has fewer than 150 valid combinations.
constraints: The number of valid combinations is less than 150.

examples.explanation: No available value can reach the target.

approaches.name: Backtrack With Reuse
approaches.summary: Choose candidates from a nondecreasing index range, allowing the same index again until the remaining target is zero.
thinkingSteps: Track the current combination and remaining sum.
When choosing a candidate, recurse from its own index so reuse is allowed.
Stop at zero remaining sum or when choices are too large.

bullets: A number may be chosen repeatedly.
Reordering the same chosen numbers is not a new combination.
The target limits how deep a choice path can go.

easier.title: Subsets
easier.reason: Practice enumerating choices without repetition first.
